Running command: cat > /workspace/candidate_trace.json << 'EOF'
[
  {"step": 1, "file": "src/protocols/tacacs/decode.c", "function": "fr_tacacs_decode", "line": 260, "var": "buffer", "code": "pkt = (fr_tacacs_packet_t const *) buffer; end = buffer + buffer_len;", "note": "Attacker-controlled TACACS packet bytes enter the decoder; header parsed as fr_tacacs_packet_t."},
  {"step": 2, "file": "src/protocols/tacacs/decode.c", "function": "fr_tacacs_decode", "line": 300, "var": "pkt->hdr.type", "code": "switch (pkt->hdr.type)", "note": "type=0x02 (AUTHOR) and seq_no=2 (even) select the Authorization RESPONSE branch."},
  {"step": 3, "file": "src/protocols/tacacs/decode.c", "function": "fr_tacacs_decode", "line": 470, "var": "pkt->author.res.arg_cnt", "code": "tacacs_decode_args(ctx, cursor, attr_tacacs_argument_list, pkt->author.res.arg_cnt, BODY(author.res), &p, end)", "note": "arg_cnt=1; the argument length list and argument data are passed to tacacs_decode_args."},
  {"step": 4, "file": "src/protocols/tacacs/decode.c", "function": "tacacs_decode_args", "line": 90, "var": "buffer", "code": "memcpy(buffer, p, arg_list[i]); buffer[arg_list[i]] = '\\0';", "note": "The 9-byte argument 'Data=0x\\xff\\xff' is copied into the local buffer[256]; arg_end = buffer+9."},
  {"step": 5, "file": "src/protocols/tacacs/decode.c", "function": "tacacs_decode_args", "line": 120, "var": "da", "code": "da = fr_dict_attr_by_name(NULL, fr_dict_root(dict_tacacs), (char *) buffer);", "note": "Name 'Data' resolves to attr_tacacs_data which is FR_TYPE_OCTETS, so the value will be parsed as octets."},
  {"step": 6, "file": "src/protocols/tacacs/decode.c", "function": "tacacs_decode_args", "line": 150, "var": "value", "code": "fr_pair_value_from_str(vp, (char const *) value, arg_end - value, 0, true)", "note": "value points to '0x\\xff\\xff' (4 bytes) inside buffer[256]; passed to pair value parser."},
  {"step": 7, "file": "src/lib/util/pair.c", "function": "fr_pair_value_from_str", "line": 1650, "var": "vp->da->type", "code": "fr_value_box_from_str(vp, &vp->data, vp->da->type, vp->da, value, inlen, quote, tainted)", "note": "For FR_TYPE_OCTETS, forwards the '0x...' string to fr_value_box_from_str."},
  {"step": 8, "file": "src/lib/util/value.c", "function": "fr_value_box_from_str", "line": 4490, "var": "in", "code": "fr_base16_decode(NULL, &FR_DBUFF_TMP(p, ret), &FR_SBUFF_IN(in + 2, len), false)", "note": "Value starts with '0x', so the remaining 2 bytes (0xff 0xff) are decoded as base16."},
  {"step": 9, "file": "src/lib/util/base16.c", "function": "fr_base16_decode_nstd", "line": 154, "var": "p[0]", "code": "a = fr_is_base16_nstd(p[0], alphabet); b = fr_is_base16_nstd(p[1], alphabet);", "note": "p[0]=0xff is passed to fr_is_base16_nstd."},
  {"step": 10, "file": "src/lib/util/base16.h", "function": "fr_is_base16_nstd", "line": 51, "var": "alphabet[(uint8_t)c]", "code": "return alphabet[(uint8_t)c] < 16;", "note": "(uint8_t)0xff = 255 indexes alphabet[255], but fr_base16_alphabet_decode_mc is declared [UINT8_MAX] (255 bytes), so index 255 reads 1 byte past the global array -> Global-buffer-overflow READ 1."}
]
EOF
echo "written"; python3 -c "import json; json.load(open('/workspace/candidate_trace.json')); print('valid json')"
